purpose: Choose the next assessment case from observed weak signals instead of random repetition.
rules: Prefer cases linked to dimensions with the lowest rolling average score.
Prefer tracks and topics with fewer attempts or lower recent scores.
Do not repeat one of the last three cases unless the user explicitly filters to it.
After a score below 12/21, select a related case at the same or lower reasoning level before increasing difficulty.
After three consecutive scores of 18/21 or higher in the same track, prefer a harder reasoning level or a cross-process case.
Cross-process cases receive a diversity bonus when several single-domain cases were attempted recently.
A manual track or reasoning-level filter is a hard constraint; weighting applies only inside the filtered pool.

selection_output.selection_reason: human-readable explanation based on weak dimensions, track coverage, level, and recency
selection_output.focus_dimensions: one to three dimensions to watch in the answer

privacy: The browser implementation stores attempt history in localStorage only. No answer text or scoring history is sent to the site owner.
